predecessors.text: Dong'ou, 'an ancient kingdom in modern Wenzhou and Taizhou, Zhejiang Province, China' (Dong'ou page)

predecessors.name: Minyue
predecessors.text: Dong'ou, 'an ancient kingdom in modern Wenzhou and Taizhou, Zhejiang Province, China' (Dong'ou page)

successors.name: Han dynasty
successors.text: Dong'ou, 'an ancient kingdom in modern Wenzhou and Taizhou, Zhejiang Province, China' (Dong'ou page)

ledger.x: 192: Emperor Gaozu of Han gives the realm of Dong'ou to Zou Yao.
138: a Han fleet makes Minyue withdraw.
138: the king of Dong'ou submits to Han and the kingdom passes to Han.

wars.name: Minyue-Dong'ou war
wars.outcome: Minyue besieged Dong'ou's capital; a Han fleet from Kuaiji made Minyue withdraw (Emperor Wu page); the Dong'ou infobox says 'Defeated by Minyue: 138 BC' and the Dong'ou king submitted to Han in 138 (Dong'ou page).

certainty.note: No page gives a frontier; the two prefectures are named, not bounded.
